title: THE ICON FILLS ITS CELL
why: His order of 2026-10-03: the item graphics need massive improvement. A 40 px picture sat in a 200 px stash cell, so the thing you were looking at was a tenth of its box. Stash and backpack cells now show the icon at 62 percent of the cell at every layout, shop cells at 44 percent, and the painters draw at up to six times the row size, so the big picture is a sharp one. The belt keys keep their small picture.
now: Item and gun pictures now fill their cells in the stash, backpack and shop instead of sitting small in the middle.

edits.anchor: .invgrid .ic{ image-rendering:auto; }   /* v18.09: painted sharp at four times the row size and scaled down smooth (was pixelated) */
